items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: And those other boys, all those boys, as Moran's played music. It's like I have six boys.

ctx.x: Oh yes, I knew that they were related, because I got a picture of Arnold, DuPas, Rudolph. Well, I know I played the drum.

Rudolph played the drum, but Dave played the clarinet. And those other boys, all those boys, as Moran's played music. It's like I have six boys. I have Joe, he plays bass. I have my little boy, he plays the piano and the organ. Elliot, he's been the line half for three years. I have Charles, he's played the sax, the clarinet, the flute, the baritone. I have the next one, August, he plays the trumpet, he plays the organ. I have Morton, he plays the piano and the trumpet. That's only five, short of one of them, I…
Well, there were a couple of other trumpet players on the front of my mind. Joe Johnson, do you remember him on the trumpet from uptown? Lee Collins used to tell me about it.
